description: List saved reply snippets for the Unified Inbox (Studio and Pro), ordered by most used. Snippets may include {name} to insert the commenter or reviewer’s first name. Changes nothing.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

category.description: Filter saved replies by category: "all" (default), "comment", or "review".

name: inbox_replies_list
title: List saved inbox replies
